identity.name: market for transport, freight, inland waterways, barge

limitations: Exact3.9cutoff freight-service screening proxies per signed tonne-km, positive1tkm source/native references and factor+1. RoW inland-waterway barge source is itself extrapolated from European Rhine-fleet data and includes vessel, port/canal, operation, fuel and emissions. Use complete native RER Transport,barge once; vessel lifetime/performance, loading, port/canal allocation, geography, emissions and vintage differ. Brazilian >32ton EURO5 freight uses the complete native RER-labelled32t-40t fleet-average service rather than an all-size Swiss fleet. Native documentation explicitly says Swiss2020fleet shares/HBEFA5.1 despite the RER label. This is not a Brazilian or EURO5-specific inventory: source includes Brazilian ProconveP7/EURO5,12%biodiesel/10ppmS diesel, local emissions and utilization. Size-class upper bound, actual payload, empty returns, fleet standards, fuel carbon/biodiesel, emissions, road/vehicle infrastructure, geography and vintage differ with unquantified score and carbon effects. Preserve caller signed tonne-km and supported uncertainties/formulas; do not infer distance, tonnes, payload or an efficiency multiplier from GVW classes. Reuse each complete transport inventory once without adding another diesel, infrastructure, tailpipe emissions or empty-return multiplier. Separate caller emissions and carbon-resource exchanges remain unchanged. Existing3.8barge parent, target and approval are retained byte-for-byte; only its independently inspected3.9scope is newly admitted. Only exact3.9cutoff lorry source qualifies; no consequential/reverse or other-version approval. No helper or source omission is added. Full pulp heat and steel transformation/export remain unfinished.
